rationale.conceptual: The task requires implementing the modified Callaway model with a non-standard generation term derived from cubic anharmonicity, plus numerical integration over phonon frequencies and fitting to experimental data. While the equations are provided, proper handling of polarization branches, the frequency window for generation, and the fitting process make this a non-trivial implementation of an established but multi-part algorithm.
rationale.execution: The workflow consists of three fitting stages and one final curve computation, outputting a single JSON file. No complex orchestration, external tooling, or data assembly beyond hard-coded material parameters is needed; standard Python/NumPy suffices.
